text.Fleet HQ:
How to Play Edit ==
When you play Fleet HQ all your ships played with the Fleet HQ in play get 1 Combat Power. Fleet HQ is an Base with a defense of 8. 
 Strategy Edit ==
Hard to get by this Base at a cost of 8. But do you let your opponent have it? Adding 1 Combat to each ship doesn't sound that much. But the numbers can add up quite fast. And can you or your opponents afford it to let it in play? Best have it at your side or scrap it out of the trade row before your opponents can get it.
